name: 07103 · Newark, NJ
findings: ZIP 07103 (Newark) has 230 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07103 (Newark) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07103 (Newark) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
